title: 列車自動駕駛系統
summary: 本課聚焦由速度規畫到停準驗證的自動駕駛閉迴路。從停準制動軌跡建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把節能滑行與回生與速度閉迴路時序連成可驗證的介面，最後以停準重複試驗推論整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies automatic-driving feedback from speed planning to stopping verification. Start with stopping brake trajectory to define physical or information boundaries, connect coasting and regenerative energy with speed-loop timing budget as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through inference from repeated stopping tests. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究停準制動軌跡。原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。敏感度只改 v=20 至 22 m/s，輸出變為 335.5 m；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究舒適加速度過渡：原創假想教學輸入：起始加速度 a0=0 m/s2；終點加速度 a1=0.9 m/s2；過渡時間 dt=3 s。公式 y=(a1-a0)/dt，代入得 y=0.3 m/s3。邊界：僅計線性加速度斜坡的平均加加速度，不代表振動舒適度完整指標。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元比較相同站距下的早煞與晚煞軌跡，將停車位置誤差分成延遲與制動能力兩部分。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate stopping brake trajectory. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. For sensitivity, change only v=20 to 22 m/s; the output becomes 335.5 m. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate comfortable acceleration transitions: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial acceleration a0=0 m/s2; final acceleration a1=0.9 m/s2; transition time dt=3 s. Formula y=(a1-a0)/dt gives y=0.3 m/s3. Boundary: Average jerk of a linear acceleration ramp only; this is not a complete vibration-comfort metric. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Compare early and late braking over the same approach, separating stopping-position error caused by latency from error caused by available deceleration. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 停準制動軌跡與舒適加速度過渡
stages.titleEn: Stopping brake trajectory & Comfortable acceleration transitions
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停準制動軌跡」與「舒適加速度過渡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stopping brake trajectory" and "Comfortable acceleration transitions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停準制動軌跡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stopping brake trajectory: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停準制動軌跡」如何影響列車自動駕駛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stopping brake trajectory” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train operation systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較相同站距下的早煞與晚煞軌跡，將停車位置誤差分成延遲與制動能力兩部分。停止距離由反應期間的等速前進與制動期間的動能消散相加。速度增加會同時增加兩項，而減速度只影響第二項；把控制命令發出時間當成制動力建立時間會漏掉一段距離。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停準制動軌跡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare early and late braking over the same approach, separating stopping-position error caused by latency from error caused by available deceleration. Stopping distance combines constant-speed travel during response with kinetic-energy removal during braking. Speed changes both contributions, whereas deceleration changes only the second. A command timestamp is not the instant at which the full braking force becomes available. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stopping brake trajectory” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度提高一成時停止距離也必定只增加一成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing speed by ten percent always increases stopping distance by exactly ten percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停準制動軌跡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stopping brake trajectory”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 停準制動軌跡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stopping brake trajectory: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停準制動軌跡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stopping brake trajectory” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：初速 v=20 m/s；定減速度大小 a=0.8 m/s2；反應時間 tau=1.5 s。公式 y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a)，代入得 y=280 m。邊界：平直路線、定減速度、無輪滑；未含坡度、黏著變動或制動建立曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial speed v=20 m/s; constant deceleration magnitude a=0.8 m/s2; response time tau=1.5 s. Formula y=v*tau+v*v/(2*a) gives y=280 m. Boundary: Level track, constant deceleration and no slip; gradients, adhesion variation and brake build-up curves are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 停準制動軌跡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stopping brake trajectory: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停準制動軌跡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stopping brake trajectory” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一時基記錄速度、制動命令與加速度，分別積分反應段及減速段，再與實際位移比較。以「停準制動軌跡」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record speed, brake command and acceleration on one clock, integrate response and deceleration separately, and compare their sum with measured displacement. For stopping brake trajectory, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把初速 v 從 20 改成 22 m/s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 280 變為 335.5 m。先說明「停準制動軌跡」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only initial speed v from 20 to 22 m/s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 280 to 335.5 m. Explain the causal direction for stopping brake trajectory, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

steps.title: 停準制動軌跡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stopping brake trajectory: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停準制動軌跡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stopping brake trajectory” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 減速度偏低與反應延遲都會使停車超出目標，但速度曲線的起始轉折可以區分兩種原因。回到「停準制動軌跡」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Weak deceleration and delayed response both cause an overrun, but the onset of the speed-curve change distinguishes these causes. Trace the input chain for stopping brake trajectory. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. steps.instruction: 本單元比較定力區與功率受限區的加速需求，檢查速度規畫是否要求致動器無法提供的力。牽引力先克服阻力，剩餘部分才增加列車動量。輪周機械功率等於牽引力乘速度，因此低速大力不必然等於高功率；電源側功率另受效率、輔助負載及回生可受納性影響。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：集中質量與定阻力模型，未含輪軸轉動慣量、坡度或黏著上限。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「牽引力功率限制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare acceleration demand in force-limited and power-limited regions, checking whether a speed plan asks for more force than the actuator can deliver. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：等效質量 m=180000 kg；速度 v=22 m/s；回收效率 eta=0.7 1。公式 y=0.5*m*v*v*eta/3.6e6，代入得 y=8.47 kWh。邊界：忽略旋轉動能、坡度位能及輔機，效率固定且假設有足夠受納容量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 地標資料年齡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Age of landmark observations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地標資料年齡」如何影響列車自動駕駛系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Age of landmark observations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic train operation systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元追蹤地標通過到速度控制器採用資料的時間，避免把高定位精度誤認為低控制延遲。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地標資料年齡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Track time from landmark passage to use by the speed controller, avoiding confusion between precise positioning and low control-loop latency. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Age of landmark observations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 停準重複試驗推論：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inference from repeated stopping tests” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 反覆重跑相同狀態可能沒有增加獨立證據，刪去失敗案例則直接破壞零失效假設。回到「停準重複試驗推論」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated identical states may add no independent evidence, while deleting failures invalidates the zero-failure assumption. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：獨立同分布二元試驗且觀察零失效，非每小時失效率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Independent identical binary trials with zero observed failures, not an hourly failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完成很多次沒有故障的測試就能證明故障機率為零」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
